Save Report this job The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows. The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations. Role Overview We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes. This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services. You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. What You’ll Do Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy Responsibilities Technical Delivery Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms. Marketing Technology Engineering Own and enhance capabilities across: Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing Marketing enrichment and data normalization Campaign and campaign member management Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management Territory planning and account assignment Activity and engagement management Outreach and business development workflows Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting Annual planning and operational planning processes Integration and System Design Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms. Data Quality and Governance Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data. Engineering Excellence Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns. Platform Optimization Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required Success Measures In 3 Months Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment. In 6 Months Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations. In 12 Months Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy. Save Report this job The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build reliable, intuitive, and scalable full-stack products for Member Records, the care-team-member-facing context layer within CareHub. Member Records surfaces the right member information at the right moment so each care-team interaction is informed and actionable, reducing the need to search across fragmented systems. The experience brings together the context care-team members need to support a member, including member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indication, and history. Current product work also includes helping care-team members understand device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions, especially when a member is active in more than one program. Member Records is part of the broader Member Record & Configurator pod. The adjacent Configurator experience gives physical therapists a way to review and personalize exercise therapy programs, while Member Records provides the member context needed to make those decisions. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to turn complex workflows into simple experiences. You will contribute from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys owning meaningful product areas end to end, makes sound technical trade-offs, and raises the quality of the systems and team around them. What You'll Accomplish Design and deliver full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Build maintainable frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, and data models for member-record workflows. Translate ambiguous product and workflow requirements into clear technical designs and incremental delivery plans. Collaborate with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and partner engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, and maintainability of production systems. Write high-quality, well-tested code and contribute to effective testing strategies across the stack. Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, incident response, and operational improvements. Identify technical debt and make pragmatic improvements that help the team move faster safely. Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, thoughtful reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Use modern developer and AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development quality and productivity. Hinge Health Hybrid Model We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru). Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software. 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development. 3+years backend experience with Node.js, service development, API design, and integration patterns. 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor Preferred Qualifications Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization, Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices. Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows. About Hinge Health At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care. As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/ What You'll Love About Us Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). Well-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. Culture & Engagement Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy. Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.
